identity.export: exclude private/public installation keys and device ID from portable archive
identity.import: never activate imported identity; preserve current local identity/journal atomically or perform separately reviewed local revocation/reset; do not regenerate missing identity with prior journal or drop a bound journal

foreground.export: exclude active registration/cursor/batch; immutable unknown-operation/event evidence may remain in separately encrypted local archive, without installation private key or credential strings
foreground.import: never activate imported registrations, unknown operations, cursors or pending batches; preserve originals as inactive archive, never query/reissue against a new device identity
foreground.failures: unknown/future/corrupt/oversized input preserves original bytes and blocks; no reset/skip/promotion

preferenceAndReceiptContract: migration-contract.json still applies: migrated preferences disabled with new revision/higher generation; imported local click tickets/leases stay inactive; reading ledger owned by P7
parentFence: invalidate parent presentation fence before migration; stop monitor; retain original authorized snapshot for pending revocation; no imported key or status revision equality may resolve an unknown mutation
implementation: narrow inventory/reset contract only; no second P9 migrator; shared migration not edited
